user.title: Acoustic Alarm Detector
user.description: Adds the binary sensors reported by the Acoustic Alarm Detector add-on. Make sure the add-on is installed and has started at least once, then select Submit. Sensors appear under one "Acoustic Alarm Detector" device.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only one Acoustic Alarm Detector instance is needed; it serves every detector from the add-on.
